room_rent.display: Per Certificate of Insurance: 1%/2% of SI, Twin/Single room, or actuals
room_rent.note: The employer/group picks one: Option A 1% or 2% of base SI per day; Option B Twin Sharing or Single Private Room; Option C actuals up to base SI. Higher room means proportionate deduction.

icu.display: Per Certificate: 2x room rent/day or actuals
icu.note: Option 1: double the room-rent limit per day; Option 2: actuals up to sum insured.

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay found; co-pay/zone options may be opted per schedule. VERIFY

sub_limits.note: Modern treatment limits and some sub-limits per Certificate of Insurance. VERIFY

deductible.note: Aggregate deductible may be opted per schedule

initial_waiting.note: VERIFY exact initial waiting in schedule

ped_waiting.note: The group chooses 12, 24, 36 or 48 months; check the Certificate of Insurance.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific illness waiting 12 or 24 months per schedule

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered. No maternity benefit or option in this wording.

cumulative_bonus.note: Group chooses 10%, 20% or 25% per claim-free year, capped at 200% of base SI.

restoration.display: Per Certificate: ReAssure (unlimited) or Re-fill (up to 5x)
restoration.note: Group may choose ReAssure (unlimited reinstatement up to base SI per claim, for different or same illness) or Re-fill (up to 5 times base SI), not both.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalization days per Policy Schedule. VERIFY

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalization days per Policy Schedule. VERIFY

day_care.note: Schedule states whether all day-care or 536 listed procedures covered

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment up to 50% of the sum insured, minimum 24-hour admission in an AYUSH hospital.

ambulance.note: Emergency road + air ambulance; options/limits per schedule; only when hospitalization claim paid. VERIFY

consumables.note: Non-medical items in List I are not payable.

global_cover.note: All benefits are available in India only.

grace_period.note: 30 days annual; 15 days for monthly instalments

notable_exclusions.display: Highly schedule-configured (group product); maternity 10mo wait; modern treatment sub-limits per schedule

optional_riders.display: AYUSH Benefit, ReAssure / Re-fill, room category options, PED/specific waiting options, air ambulance, co-pay options
